segments.summary: Reviewed all onboarding review, setup, provider setup, planning-wizard navigation, and skip/review controls. The wiring, receipt/event split, and accessibility evidence are explicit; payload schemas, atomic availability transitions, and navigation outcome semantics remain underdefined.

Reviewed build-run, compare, focus, artifact, concern, and conflict-assistant controls. Common receipt and accessibility contracts are strong, while build-run effects, target identity and authority, and failure or retry transitions are not canonicalized.

Reviewed corroboration, Docker, GitHub Actions, graph generation and patch, and open-in integration controls. No-persist receipts and layered evidence are explicit; external authority, unsafe-target handling, overlapping command semantics, and offline or partial-failure recovery are absent.

Reviewed source-control, Kubernetes, preview artifact, promotion, receipt, review, and source-control navigation controls. Receipt and negative-event oracles are consistent; target authorization, pending and failure GUI truth, localization, and route destination seams remain unspecified.
